课程简介（中文）

本课程致力于通过系统而深入的语言教学，全面提升学生的英语语言运用能力。课程内容涵盖听力、口语、阅读、写作和翻译等关键语言技能，并通过一系列课堂活动、作业和线上辅助练习，激发学生的学习热情。学生将在深入探索语言知识的同时，深化对于相关社会文化因素的理解，洞察语言表达的微妙之处和有效沟通的影响力。

课程简介（英文）

The course is designed to enhance students’ overall language proficiency through a comprehensive and systematic approach. It focuses on developing listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation skills through a variety of engaging classroom activities, homework assignments, and online supplementary exercises.

Students will be exposed to new linguistic phenomena, fostering a deeper understanding of the socio-cultural dimensions inherent in language learning. They will also gain insights into the subtleties of language expression and the impact of effective communication.

教学目标

Integrated College English, as a comprehensive course, not only aims to equip students with the necessary language skills to meet the Levels 4-5 of China’s Standards of English Language Ability but also seeks to enrich their educational experience in the following several aspects:

  1. Language Proficiency and Effective Communication: The course will hone students’ abilities in listening, speaking, reading, writing, and translation, with a special emphasis on both written and oral communication.
  2. Cultural Awareness and Appreciation: The course will incorporate elements of cultural studies, encouraging students to appreciate the diversity of English-speaking cultures and to develop a global perspective.
  3. Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: Students will be guided to think critically about the information they encounter in English texts, fostering the ability to question, analyze, and synthesize information.
  4. Digital Literacy: Given the course’s emphasis on computer-assisted learning, students will also develop digital literacy skills. They will learn how to effectively use technology for language learning and communication, preparing them for the digital age.
  5. Lifelong Learning and Self-improvement: The course will instill a passion for lifelong learning and self-improvement, encouraging students to continue developing their English skills beyond the classroom and to seek out opportunities for personal and professional growth.

教学方式

Lecture-based, with the teacher providing in-depth or general explanations of texts, vocabulary, and various language knowledge and skills, supplemented by group discussions, group presentations, or other forms of classroom activities.

教学内容与进度安排

Week 1  Orientation

Key Points:

- A brief introduction of the course, including course content, course schedule, general requirements, etc.

- Getting to know each other

 

Weeks 2-3  Unit 1 Never Judge by Appearances

Key Points:

- The danger of judging people by their appearances

- The situations in which people are likely to judge by appearances

- Writing skills: writing a personal portrait

Course Readings:

Li Yinhua et al.  New Advanced College English Integrated Course 3.  pp. 2-37

Additional listening & reading materials at http://elearning.fudan.edu.cn

 

Weeks 4-6  Unit 2 Security

Key Points:

- America’s transformation from “the land of the free” to “the land of the lock”

- Security issues on campus

- Speaking skills: talking about how to enhance security awareness

Course Readings:

Li Yinhua et al.  New Advanced College English Integrated Course 3.  pp. 38-75

Additional listening & reading materials at http://elearning.fudan.edu.cn

 

Week 5  National Day Holiday or Group Project

In-class activities including group presentation, group role-play, debate etc.

 

Weeks 7-8  Unit 3 Managing Personal Finances

Key Points:

- Being caught in the debt trap

- The young generation’s spending habits

- Writing skills: writing a summary

Course Readings:

Li Yinhua et al.  New Advanced College English Integrated Course 3.  pp. 76-117

Additional listening & reading materials at http://elearning.fudan.edu.cn

 

Week 9  Mid-term Exam

an in-class test based on the first three units in New Advanced College English Integrated Course 3, covering listening, vocabulary, reading, etc.

 

Weeks 10-11  Unit 4 Ways of Learning

Key Points:

- The Chinese way of learning versus the Western way of learning

- How to improve your way of learning

- Speaking skills: using comparison and contrast

Course Readings:

Li Yinhua et al.  New Advanced College English Integrated Course 3.  pp. 118-153

Additional listening & reading materials at http://elearning.fudan.edu.cn

 

Weeks 12-13  Unit 5 Fighting with the Forces of Nature

Key Points:

- How the power of nature shaped the course of human history

- More examples of wars in Chinese history

- Writing skills: indicating cause and effect

Course Readings:

Li Yinhua et al.  New Advanced College English Integrated Course 3.  pp. 154-189

Additional listening & reading materials at http://elearning.fudan.edu.cn

 

Weeks 14-15  Unit 6 China Rejuvenated

Key Points:

- The transformation of China since 1978

- The achievements our university has accomplished recently

- Speaking skills: using examples to illustrate

Course Readings:

Li Yinhua et al.  New Advanced College English Integrated Course 3.  pp. 190-224

Additional listening & reading materials at http://elearning.fudan.edu.cn

 

Week 16  Q&A

 

Week 17  Final Examination
